name: research-skills
description: Skills, agents and hooks for doing research with Claude: literature search, writing rules, referee review, claim checking.

plugins.name: lit-search
plugins.description: Literature search on OpenAlex and arXiv with citation chasing, then a swarm of small model calls reads the top papers' full text and returns verbatim quotes that code checks against the text.

plugins.name: writing-rules
plugins.description: Rules for prose a reader judges (papers, essays, grant text): reader first, structure, sentence tests, a ban list of persuasion and AI-tell words, and a lint that runs after every .tex/.md write.

plugins.name: reviewers
plugins.description: Referee-style review of research in progress or a finished draft: 2-3 reviewer agents with different angles tell the story the work could tell and give every item a verdict; a hook checks every quote they cite.

plugins.name: checker
plugins.description: Check claims, numbers and captions against the raw sources before they are trusted: a checker agent cites file:line for every objection and a hook confirms each quote is in the file.
